subject: MSA & Order Form redlines — publicity, logo use, and escrow questions
messages:
From: Claire Henderson <claire.henderson@novapulse.com>
To: sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Novapulse redlines: MSA + Order Form — publicity & logo ask

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to get the order moving. Attached are Novapulse's redlines to the MSA and Order Form (see Novapulse_Redlines_MSA_20261112.pdf). Two items we want to call out up front so your legal / sales teams can react: 

1) Publicity / press releases: we want mutual sign-off on any customer quote or joint press release and a 7-business-day review window. Our legal marked this as a required approval step.

2) Logo use & asset escrow: we have an internal marketing policy that requires an asset escrow clause for logos used in joint case studies (we provided suggested language in the redline). If Redwood prefers a more limited approach, please propose alternate wording — but we can't commit to blanket logo use without controls.

Can your legal team review and advise where Redwood can't accept these items as written? We're aiming to sign the order by end of month so appreciate a quick turnaround.

Attachments: Novapulse_Redlines_MSA_20261112.pdf (PDF with comments)

Thanks,
Claire Henderson
Head of Partnerships, Novapulse
claire.henderson@novapulse.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Claire Henderson <claire.henderson@novapulse.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Novapulse redlines: MSA + Order Form — publicity & logo ask

Claire — thanks for sending this over and for the clear callouts. We're enthusiastic to move forward.

Next steps on our side: 
- I'll loop Legal (Kimberly) for a line-by-line on the redlines.
- I'll prepare a short mutual amendment template that captures the publicity approval window and an asset-handling approach that we can iterate on.

Couple quick notes that will speed review if you can confirm: 
- Is the 7-business-day review window measured from receipt of the draft or from the moment marketing confirms final edits?
- For escrow: is Novapulse proposing a third-party asset escrow service, or simply escrow-like retention in Novapulse's internal asset library?

For reference I uploaded the current Redwood MSA baseline we will use for redlines to a shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-novapulse-msas (I've added your PDF alongside it). HubSpot deal HS:5483721 is likewise updated.

I'll aim to get Kimberly's initial position back by tomorrow EOD PST.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: claire.henderson@novapulse.com
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 14:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Novapulse redlines: MSA + Order Form — publicity & logo ask

On Thu, Nov 12, 2026 at 09:14 AM Claire Henderson <claire.henderson@novapulse.com> wrote:
> Two items we want to call out up front so your legal / sales teams can react:
> 1) Publicity / press releases: we want mutual sign-off on any customer quote or joint press release and a 7-business-day review window.
> 2) Logo use & asset escrow: we have an internal marketing policy that requires an asset escrow clause for logos used in joint case studies.

Thanks for the clear summary. Quick internal position: 

1) Publicity/quotes — we can accept mutual sign-off with a 7-business-day review window, provided the clause permits Redwood to make reasonable edits for accuracy and that the window begins on delivery of the final draft to the reviewer. We will propose language that also allows Redwood to seek an expedited sign-off if there is a pre-announced product launch tied to the customer. 

2) Logo use & escrow — we cannot agree to a third-party escrow for logo assets as a contractual requirement. What we can accept is: (a) a controlled asset delivery mechanism (Redwood will request high-res logos via a secure asset link), (b) a limited license for logo use strictly tied to the marketing materials approved under the publicity clause, and (c) an explicit non-endorsement carve-out. If Novapulse's policy requires escrow, suggest we add a requirement that Novapulse deposit logo assets with an agreed internal contact and provide a certificate of authenticity on request; we will accept that instead of a third-party escrow.

I've added redline notes directly to Redwood_MSA_Markup_kpark_20261113.pdf (attached). Major open points are labeled in the file.

If Novapulse is comfortable with the alternative to escrow (internal deposit + certificate), we're close. If not, we'll need a short call between legal and marketing to iron out the practicalities.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

From: Claire Henderson <claire.henderson@novapulse.com>
To: sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, matthew.lee@novapulse.com
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 08:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Novapulse redlines: MSA + Order Form — publicity & logo ask

Thanks Kim — that helps a lot and very reasonable. A couple clarifying points from our side: 

- The 7-business-day review would start when the draft is delivered to the reviewer. We can add language allowing either party to request an expedited 48-hour review in the case of coordinated announcements.
- For escrow: Novapulse prefers a third-party escrow for historical reasons, but we can accept the "internal deposit + certificate" route provided Redwood confirms the certificate form (we can share our standard certificate template).

To keep momentum, our marketing lead Matthew Lee is looped in. Matthew — can you share the certificate template and confirm you are OK with the 7-business-day start trigger as Claire described?

If everyone agrees, would suggest Sofia and Kim prepare a brief mutual amendment capturing: (1) publicity approval workflow and timing; (2) logo asset handling / certificate process and permitted uses; (3) example sign-off process for case studies. We can sign that as an exhibit to the Order Form.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — aiming for signature next week.

Claire

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: claire.henderson@novapulse.com, matthew.lee@novapulse.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Novapulse redlines: MSA & Order Form — publicity next steps

Claire / Matthew — great, thanks. Action items and plan: 

1) Kimberly will finalize the short amendment language by Monday that implements the 7-business-day window (measured from draft delivery) and the expedited 48-hour option.
2) Novapulse to send the certificate-of-authenticity template (Matthew). Once received, Kim will confirm whether the template meets Redwood's documentation needs or propose a one-line tweak.
3) I'll produce a single exhibit file (Mutual_Amendment_Draft_20261114.docx) that we can iterate on in the shared drive and then send for signature via DocuSign (https://www.docusign.com/ember/NP-2026-0467).

If that timeline works, I'll schedule a 30-minute alignment call on Monday morning PST to close the remaining redlines and, assuming acceptance, initiate DocuSign the same day.

Sofia Ivanova
